item.title: PAX West 2026 Bundle
item.description: Play the best of PAX West!
item.content:encoded:
Get ready to celebrate the best of nerd culture with this bundle of games in partnership with PAX West 2026! Command your heroes to victory against the Asverellian Empire in turn-based RPG Dark Deity 2! Skid and drift through the retro delights of Parking Garage Rally Circuit! Play ruthless strategy games against demonic enemies in Order Automatica! Take on the powers of gods and battle enemies solo or in co-op mode in GODBREAKERS! There’s even more nerdy fun to enjoy in this bundle, so grab these games now at the price of your choice, tune in to this year’s PAX West celebration, and support Child’s Play charity with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 18th, 2027.

item.title: Beyond the Metroidverse Bundle
item.description: The Metroidverse is calling your name
item.content:encoded:
Leave no stone unturned and kick ass in the process with the Beyond the Metroidverse Bundle. Rediscover Monster Boy and the Cursed Kingdom, the legendary Metroidvania with anime-style visuals by original series creator Ryuichi Nishizawa. Explore every nook and cranny of HunterX, the Metroidvania with a massive selection of weapons and spells to fully customize your playstyle. Or traverse a dangerous cyberpunk-inspired wasteland to find your brother in Haak. Pay what you want for a new generation of great games and help support Room to Read with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 16th, 2027.

item.title: Love Letter to Lovecraft
item.description: Our love letter to Lovecraftian gaming
item.content:encoded:
With blood dripping from our hands, we present the Love Letter to Lovecraft Bundle. Fight to rebuild what was lost as one of the last humans living in Remnant: From the Ashes, a soulslike action-adventure rooted in Eldritch themes. Embark on a journey into the darkest nightmares imaginable before you go insane in Forgive Me Father 2 Deluxe Edition, a hand-drawn Lovecraftian boomer shooter. Or maybe psychological horror is your thing—investigate the mysterious and tragic death of the Hawkins family in Call of Cthulhu. Pay what you want for thrilling experiences in gaming and help support Kiss the Ground!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 11th, 2027.

item.title: Humble 15th Anniversary - Ready Player One ... and Two
item.content:encoded:
We wouldn’t be where we are today without our friends (you!!), and to celebrate that friendship as well as our 15th Anniversary, we’ve compiled a bundle of our favorite games to play solo or with a bestie. As such, the low price tier of this bundle gets you one copy of each game, and the high tier gets you two—and saves you $4! Keep the beats bumping and the beatdowns coming in street fighting beat-’em-up Streets of Rage 4! Separate your real friends from their mimics in survival horror game Mimesis! Battle against the genetically engineered zeds in Killing Floor 3! Grab these games and more for yourself and/or a buddy for the price of your choice, and help support REVERB’s green music movement with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 11th, 2027.

item.title: Yes Chef! - Cooking Bundle
item.content:encoded:
Take your chef skills to the next level with this bundle of tasty cooking games! Whether you’re an amateur at best IRL or a seasoned professional in the kitchen, you’re sure to find the perfect cooking challenge. Keep the ale flowing and the mood high in the charmingly old-timey Tavern Manager Simulator! Let your fingers fly across the keyboard in the high-octane typing game The Chef’s Shift! (Say that three times fast.) Become the sneaky, ravenous beast you were always meant to be in arcade game Pizza Possum! Whatever your speed, whatever your tastes, this bundle of cooking games will satisfy any appetite! Grab these tasty treats while you can at the price of your choice, and support the FarmLink Project with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 9th, 2027.

item.title: Hamble's Summer Island Getaway Bundle
item.content:encoded:
Take a break and soak up some sun with all the beachy summer games in Hamble’s Summer Getaway Bundle! Play all of our friendly mascot’s favorite seasonal games, from fishing challenges to island builders and beyond! Design the perfect fish and explore the depths of Primordialis, where predators and prey are around every reef! Design your unique island paradises in a variety of new styles and biomes in Islanders: New Shores! Bring the summer fun home with all of these games and more! Pay what you choose for all eight of these sun-soaked adventures, and support Whale & Dolphin Conservation with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 9th, 2027.

item.title: Shantae & Heroic Heroines
item.content:encoded:
Embark on a world of adventure with our favorite half-genie heroine Shantae! This bundle of games features our favorite Shantae adventures plus even more girl-power games that keep the fun coming! Explore a mysterious sunken city and battle undersea foes in Shantae and the Seven Sirens! Save Sequin Land from a rampant crime wave with Shantae: Half-Genie Hero Ultimate Edition, featuring all DLC, modes, and costumes! Sail the high seas and ally with your swashbuckling nemesis in Shantae and the Pirate’s Curse! Plus, have even more fun with the schoolgirl warriors of River City Girls and the law-abiding citizens of Mighty Switch Force! Collect all these heroic heroines in one bundle, pay what you want, and support CARE with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 7th, 2027.

item.title: Built Differently: Builder Games
item.content:encoded:
Grab your hardhat and shovel because it’s time to clock in at the Built Differently: Builder Games Bundle! Save big on the Game of the Year Edition of Frostpunk, the society-first survival builder where you roleplay as ruler of the last city on Earth. Will you rule with an iron fist? Or build your empire on a foundation of lies? The choices are yours. Or unearth great games like Diplomacy Is Not an Option and Drill Core from this 10-title collection. Plus, your hard work helps support the Her Future Coalition!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 4th, 2027.

item.title: Handsome Husbandos
item.description: Build your dream life with your dream man
item.content:encoded:
The content in this bundle is intended for mature audiences.

We’re not saying your future husband is definitely living inside a video game… but you might want to grab this bundle of otome games juuust in case! We’ve selected our favorite visual novels in a variety of genres, all fully customizable so you can achieve the unforgettable adventure and heartstopping romance of your dreams. Train as a warrior and navigate the complex and deadly ninja politics of Nightshade! Fall in love in the industrial Depths of the dystopian steampunk world of Steam Prison! Grow up alongside the boy of your dreams in the seaside summer town of Our Life: Beginnings & Always, which includes the full DLC pack! There’s even more excitement and romance to be found in the visual novels in this bundle, so grab them now at the price of your choosing, and support Breakthrough T1D with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 2nd, 2027.

item.title: Indie's Support for Venezuela Bundle
item.description: Support indie devs and disaster relief!
item.content:encoded:
The recent earthquakes in Venezuela have left communities facing an urgent humanitarian crisis. We’ve teamed up with indie developers from Venezuela and around the world to assemble a collection of great games in support of relief efforts, helping provide critical aid to those affected. To better aid with Direct Relief's impact in providing assistance in the wake of these earthquakes, our developer partners have agreed to increase standard charity share for this bundle.

Build a cozy home in space for a furry-tailed friend in The Last Cat in the Universe, complete with the Supporter Pack DLC. Or try Calico, the adorable LGBTQ+-positive story of rebuilding a local cat cafe, and 10+ additional acclaimed indie titles!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 2nd, 2027.

item.title: Awesome Indie Adventures
item.content:encoded:
Looking for your next big adventure? Our newest bundle has our favorite indie games full of dynamic characters and exciting storylines for everyone ready to dive into a great story. Wield your bow and lift the curse on a mysterious island in The Pathless! Solve the puzzles to escape the Gloom in the retro survival horror game Post Trauma! Become the monsters you kill and rebuild a fallen civilization in Biomorph! There’s even more adventure to discover in this bundle, so grab these great games now at the price of your choosing and support music charity Reverb with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before February 28th, 2027.
